add `--multi-file-regex` option (#2419)

add `--multi-file-regex` option allowing to use a regular expression to group files.
On matching file paths, captured groups are replaced with `*` so that, for example, with regex  `part(\d+)`:
- `foo-part1.xyz` and `foo-part2.xyz` become `foo-part*.xyz` and are grouped together
- `bar-part1.xyz` and `bar-part2.xyz` become `bar-part*.xyz` and are together in a separate group
- non-matching files would get grouped according to `--multi-file-mode`

Detect file format by parsing file/stream header using CanReadFile (#2865)

Add support for autodetecting buffer type  when loading a buffer, which makes the following possible:
` cat file.ext | f3d -`

Note that this REQUIRES `VTK v9.6.20260128`

In order to achieve that this PR :
 - Add a `CAN_READ` in the reader CMake API, it can be `STATIC`, `MEMBER` or `CUSTOM`

It only means that the vtk reader or vtk importer as a static or member CanReadFile method to use when generating code for `canRead(stream)`.  With CUSTOM, it is expected that the CUSTOM_CODE will provide a `canRead(stream)` method.

- Without SUPPORTS_STREAM, canRead(stream) always returns true, so all such readers have seen their score reduced to avoid collision

-  BREAKING CHANGE: `canRead(fileName)` now checks the file exists and (vtk VTK 9.6.20260128) that its header is valid, this impact directly `scene::supports` public API. 
- Add a factory::getReader(buffer) to be used in `scene::add(buffer)`
- Implement a proper `scene::add(buffer)`
- Update `scene::supports` unit tests to account for behavior change
- Update assimp CUSTOM_CODE to recover and use the correct hint depending on canRead result
- Set reader SCORE according to the quality of their CanReadFile to avoid false positive
- Remove ColladaFixup and rely on MemoryHint instead for simplicity
- Implement a proper vtkF3DGLTFDracoImporter::CanReadFile to detect draco files
- Use GLTF preferentially to GLTFDraco with SCORE because we are now able to detect when a draco file cannot be read
- Adapt GLTFDraco score depending on VTK version has its impacted by the CanReadFile result
- Rework vtkF3DImageImporter, add a CanReadFile and tests to properly detect the file format 
- Add testing depends to vtkextPrivate in native plugins
- Remove many reader SCORE that were useless
- Implement many custom canRead impl
- Add many PIPED tests without --force-reader
- Update all `invalid` data to coherent namings
- Add some missing const in the libf3d API
- Add a missing extension in mimetypes

doc(integration): Don't use sudo for user files (#2976)

The Desktop Integration instructions for enabling thumbnails
have a pretty serious error, instructing the user to run
`update-mime-database` and `update-desktop-database`
with `sudo` when updating their _user_ stores.

This will result in root-owned files being written to
`$HOME/.local/share/`, which will prevent the user
from being able to update them later as they won't
have write access to those files. 

`sudo` shouldn't be used when writing to user datastores.
